message.content: In the 19th‑century art world, **Auguste Rodin’s “The Kiss” (1889)** stands out as one of the most celebrated and widely recognized sculptures. Created during the late Romantic period, it captures a tender, intimate moment between lovers, rendered with remarkable realism and emotional depth. Its influence spread across Europe and America, inspiring countless artists and becoming a symbol of romantic love in modern sculpture.
